scope: Selective backport of upstream Neroued/ninfer master onto the mainline runtime for the RTX 5090 lane (omp-ninfer #33, first tranche): watch correction, commit-by-commit selection with reasons, cherry-picks with provenance, appliance build, full suite on an ephemeral sm_120a GPU, lane qualification against the lifecycle-started candidate, independent review on the frozen subject, component publication by digest, product cut, route acceptance against the published image, and post-cut verbatim runs from the tag.
question: Can the shipped RTX 5090 runtime take the upstream engine work that touches its execution paths without changing what this product qualifies - exact retrieval, durable checkpoints, the HTTP boundary, tokenisation - and how much of the upstream delta is reachable without the deferred campaigns?
answer: Yes for 18 of 158 upstream commits. Every lane gate is within run-to-run noise of v0.6.2 and the full 102-test suite passes on the target architecture. The runtime materialization/pressure family - including the fix for upstream #229, this product's own workload - is unreachable without value-aware shared prefix scheduling, which pulls the serve-adapter campaign: that is the next engine window, with the pressure_protocol and fanout phases as its arbiter. Upstream's GDN capacity fix overlaps this product's #42 fix and needs its own merge window.
